name: SeCom

paper.title: On Memory Construction and Retrieval for Personalized Conversational Agents

stages.ingestion: Each session is split into topically coherent segments by a conversation segmentation model (zero-shot GPT-4 for QA benchmarks; Mistral-7B and a RoBERTa model fine-tuned on SuperDialSeg also tested).
stages.construction: Segments become the memory units; LLMLingua-2 (xlm-roberta-large, 75% compression rate) is applied to memory units as compression-based denoising before retrieval.
stages.retrieval: BM25 or MPNet (multi-qa-mpnet-base-dot-v1) with FAISS retrieves units under a context budget (4k tokens on LOCOMO, 1k on Long-MT-Bench+).
stages.answer: Retrieved units are placed in time order as context for the response model (GPT-35-Turbo main; Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 also tested).
stages.learning: Optional: the segmentation prompt is refined by LLM self-reflection on hard annotated examples (used for segmentation benchmarks, not for the QA runs).

summary: Builds conversational memory at topical-segment granularity and denoises memory units with LLMLingua-2 compression to improve retrieval.
notes: Venue ICLR 2025 confirmed via iclr.cc poster page and Microsoft Research page (not stated in the arXiv text itself). Code URL from the Hugging Face paper page (auto-linked); project page https://aka.ms/secom.
